info.title: RMQTT external HTTP authentication and ACL API
info.description: Unimplemented v1 external contract. MQTT username uniquely identifies the device. Authenticate client_id/username/password; authorize client_id/username/action/topic. Responses have no required body:204 allows,403 denies,401/429/5xx/other statuses are unavailable. No extra identity or response JSON. Exact-key decision caching is Broker-managed. Normative details: ../http-auth-api.md.

post.description: Username uniquely identifies the device. Broker calls business service. Only HTTP204 allows; HTTP403 denies this request, HTTP401 is a service credential error. No response JSON or identity fields. All other statuses are unavailable/protocol errors. See ../http-auth-api.md.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Optional tracing only. Service may ignore; response echo not required.

204.description: Allow. No content. Authentication binds the verified username; ACL permits this exact operation. No response Content-Type or ID echo required.

403.description: Deny this authentication or exact ACL operation. Prefer empty body; any error body ignored, never parsed or logged. Does not imply global account revocation.

401.description: Broker-to-service credentials/access problem. Unavailable; never cache as business deny or fallback to anonymous.

429.description: Backend rate limit/overload. Unavailable; no automatic retry or deadline extension.

503.description: Backend unavailable; not an explicit device denial.

default.description: Unavailable/protocol error. Includes HTTP200, every other 2xx, redirects, bad requests, endpoint404 and other5xx. Never interpret a JSON body as allow/deny. Bound discarded error bodies to4KiB then close.

post.summary: Authorize one client operation on one topic or filter

ServiceToken.description: Broker-to-service credential; not MQTT user password.

Username.description: Unique stable device identity; exact case-sensitive UTF8. Trusted for ACL only after successful authentication.

oneOf.description: Only for non-UTF8 passwords. Canonical RFC4648, decoded <=65535 bytes. Never include together with password, including null.

topic.description: Publish: concrete valid MQTT Topic Name. Subscribe: valid MQTT Topic Filter; concrete Topic used for actual receiving. Broker strips shared wrapper only for initial shared subscription. Service must authorize full requested filter range.
